resources.string: Pollenplot uses its own leaf and pollen colours. You can use the colours of your phone\'s wallpaper instead.
Pollenplot records the plants, wildlife, bees and watering in your backyard. Plants and animals are identified on your phone, and your records stay on your phone.
The software Pollenplot is built with, and the licence each part comes under.
Pollenplot is built with the software below. Please choose an item to read its licence.
This licence could not be opened. Please try again.
Your plot has no zones yet.
Zones are the areas of your yard, such as a front native strip, a citrus patch or a hive corner. You will be able to add zones and place your plants, hives and bee hotels in them here.
Nectar and pollen through the year
Pollen Rhythms needs plants in your plot.
Once your plants are added, this page shows what is flowering now, what is coming up next, and the months when your honey bees or native bees may be short of food.
No wildlife has been recorded yet.
Birds, insects, frogs, reptiles, fish and other animals that you photograph in your yard will be listed here, with the plants they use.
You have no honey bee hives yet.
Your European honey bee hives, inspections, Varroa mite checks and harvests will be kept here, with a guide written for Australian beekeepers.
You have no native bee hives yet.
Your stingless native bee hives, splits and harvests will be kept here, together with sightings of solitary native bees and a guide to keeping them.
You have no bee hotels yet.
Your bee and insect hotels, the cavities that are sealed or occupied, and their upkeep will be kept here.
No watering lines have been set up yet.
Once your zones and plants are in place, this page recommends when to water and how much, based on the weather and on what each plant needs.
